translation.ADDON_CASH_WALLET_AND_REFUNDS_DESCRIPTIO: Our Cash Wallet offers a secure, convenient way for customers to manage funds and transact on your platform.
translation.ADDON_CASH_WALLET_AND_REFUNDS_FULL_DESCR: Our Cash Wallet feature revolutionizes how customers manage funds within your platform, offering a secure and convenient way to conduct transactions.nFrom swift payments to comprehensive financial control, enhance the shopping journey with the added flexibility of a Cash Wallet. nPlus, facilitate hassle-free refunds directly to customers' wallets, encouraging future purchases on your platform.
translation.ADDON_CATERING_DESCRIPTION: Our Catering feature simplifies the intricacies of catering services, offering a streamlined solution for both pickup and delivery options.
translation.ADDON_CATERING_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Our Catering feature simplifies the intricacies of catering services, offering a streamlined solution for both pickup and delivery options. nWith customizable menus, preparation times, and delivery windows, you can offer a tailored and efficient catering experience. nThis comprehensive system ensures your business meets customer expectations with ease, from advanced booking to order fulfillment.

translation.ADDON_DELIVERY_COMPANIES_DESCRIPTION: Optimize your delivery operations by incorporating third-party delivery services.
translation.ADDON_DELIVERY_COMPANIES_FULL_DESCRIPTIO: Optimize your delivery operations by incorporating third-party delivery services such as DoorDash Drive, DoorDash Classic, Rappi, Glovo, Wolt, Lalamove, and Uber Direct into your platform. nOur system is engineered to seamlessly connect with new endpoints, facilitating quick and efficient integration. Tailor the delivery process to your business needs, from setting specific rules for when to use third-party services to manual company selection for individual orders.
translation.ADDON_GIFT_CARDS_DESCRIPTION: Introduce the ultimate convenience in gifting with Ordering Gift Cards.
translation.ADDON_GIFT_CARDS_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Introduce the ultimate convenience in gifting with Ordering Gift Cards. Perfect for any occasion, from birthdays to holidays, our versatile gift cards offer your customers a thoughtful way to show they care. nEnable easy purchase and redemption through your platform, bolstering customer satisfaction and loyalty. nWith e-gift card options, adapt to the modern gifting trend and provide a seamless experience for givers and receivers alike.
translation.ADDON_MULTI_BUSINESS_CHECKOUT_DESCRIPTIO: Introduce a seamless multi-store ordering experience with our Multi-Business Checkout feature.
translation.ADDON_MULTI_BUSINESS_CHECKOUT_FULL_DESCR: Introduce a seamless multi-store ordering experience with our Multi-Business Checkout feature. Allow customers to effortlessly combine purchases from groceries, multiple restaurants, and other providers into a single transaction. nThis innovative approach streamlines the checkout process, enhances order management, and offers versatile purchasing options, making it easier for customers to shop across different businesses simultaneously.
translation.ADDON_POINT_WALLET_AND_LEVELS_DESCRIPTIO: Introducing a customizable Loyalty Points & Levels system designed to enrich your customer relationships and incentivize repeat business.
translation.ADDON_POINT_WALLET_AND_LEVELS_FULL_DESCR: Introducing a customizable Loyalty Points & Levels system designed to enrich your customer relationships and incentivize repeat business. nBy rewarding purchases with points and recognizing customer loyalty through tiered levels, you create a compelling win-win scenario.nTailor the program with store-specific rules, currency values, and unique benefits, crafting an engaging loyalty experience that mirrors global best practices like the Starbucks star system.

translation.ADDON_STRIPE_CONNECT_DESCRIPTION: Stripe Connect transforms how payments are managed within your marketplace.
translation.ADDON_STRIPE_CONNECT_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Stripe Connect transforms how payments are managed within your marketplace, enabling automatic splits between your business and your stores. nThis powerful integration not only simplifies the transaction process but also aligns with your specific contractual agreements, offering a seamless solution for distributing fees and revenues. nSet up in less than 24 hours, this feature requires only your Stripe account to get started.
translation.ADDON_WHITE_LABEL_DESCRIPTION: Embrace full brand autonomy with our Advanced White-labeled Bundle.
translation.ADDON_WHITE_LABEL_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Embrace full brand autonomy with our Advanced White-labeled Bundle. This comprehensive package removes all traces of Ordering.co, allowing your marketplace to shine under your exclusive brand.nLeverage our multimillion-dollar technology investment to become an unstoppable force in the marketplace sector, all without worrying about the underlying tech. n Transform your marketplace with our white-labeled solution, combining the power of our technology with the unique identity of your brand. This is your opportunity to stand out and scale up, backed by the most advanced no-code platform for marketplaces.

translation.BUILDER_CREDENTIAL_ERROR_TYPE: _field_: this type of file isn’t accepted.
translation.BUILDER_CREDENTIALS_ANDROID_HELP: Keystore used to sign the Android app, plus the Play Store service account.
translation.BUILDER_CREDENTIALS_IOS_HELP: Team and API key used to sign and upload the iOS app.
translation.BUILDER_CREDENTIALS_SAVED: Saved. Used to sign the next build.
translation.BUILDER_DEFAULT_KEYSTORE_CONFIRM_HELP: If this app is already published with your keystore, the store will reject updates signed with a different one. Your keystore and its passwords are removed when you save.
translation.BUILDER_DEFAULT_KEYSTORE_CONFIRM_TITLE: Replace your keystore with the default one?
translation.BUILDER_DEFAULT_KEYSTORE_HELP: The app is signed with the default keystore. Turn this off to use your own.
translation.BUILDER_DEFAULT_KEYSTORE_UNAVAILABLE: The default keystore isn’t available right now. Upload your own or try again later.
translation.BUILDER_DISABLED_HELP: Builder is turned off for this installation.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_HELP: Your website opens at this domain, with HTTPS.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ACTIVE_KEEP: Keep the CNAME record in your DNS. If you remove it, this domain stops working.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_CHANGE_WARNING: When you save, _domain_ stops opening your website. Create the CNAME record for the new domain first: we check it when you save.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_FAILED_HELP: Check that the domain is spelled right and that its CNAME record points to _target_, then verify again. If it keeps failing, contact support.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_CREATE_RECORD: Create this record in your domain’s DNS, then save again
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_CNAME: We couldn’t find a CNAME record for _domain_.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_INVALID: Enter a valid domain, like www.yourbrand.com.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_RESTRICTED: This domain can’t be used. Enter a domain of your own.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_ROOT: _domain_ is a root domain, and a root domain can’t have a CNAME record.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_TAKEN: This domain is already used by another website.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED: This website’s domain is managed by support. Contact support to change it.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_FIELD_HELP: The full subdomain, like shop.yourbrand.com. You can paste the whole address.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_FULL_NAME: Some providers ask for the full name, _domain_. If you just created it, wait a few minutes and save again.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_KEEP_RECORD: Meanwhile your website keeps opening at its temporary address. Keep the CNAME record _name_ → _target_ in your DNS.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_LOST_HELP: Verify again to set it up again. Check first that its CNAME record still points to _target_.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_ONCE_SAVED: Once the record is saved in your provider:
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_PENDING_HELP: We’re checking the CNAME record and getting the security certificate (HTTPS). This takes a few minutes, up to about 20. This page updates by itself, so you can leave it and come back.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_REMOVE_ERROR: We couldn’t remove the domain. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_REMOVE_HELP: Your website stops opening at _domain_ right away.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_REMOVE_TEMPORARY: It stays online at _temporary_. You can add a domain again later.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_SAVE_ERROR: We couldn’t save the domain. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_SAVED: Saved. We’re setting up _domain_; it takes a few minutes.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_CNAME_HELP: in the DNS settings of the provider where you bought your domain:
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_SAVE: Enter your domain here and save.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_SAVE_HELP: We check the record when you save, so create it first.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_WAIT: Wait until your provider saves it.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_STEP_WAIT_HELP: It usually takes a few minutes.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_MISSING: The CNAME record for _domain_ still isn’t there. Check it in your provider and try again in a few minutes.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_STILL_TEMPORARY: Your website keeps opening at its temporary address.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_TEMPORARY_HELP: Always works, also after you add your own domain.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_TIMEOUT_HELP: The CNAME record wasn’t found, or it was removed. Check that it points to _target_, then verify again.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_OWN_HELP: Show your website at an address like www.yourbrand.com. It has to be a subdomain (www., shop., order.…): a root domain like yourbrand.com can’t be used.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_USE_SUBDOMAIN: Use a subdomain, like _domain_, and create its record
translation.BUILDER_DOMAIN_VERIFY_ERROR: We couldn’t verify the domain. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_DOMAINS_HELP: The addresses where people open your website.
translation.BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_ERROR: We couldn’t download the file. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_MISSING: This build’s file is no longer available. Build again to get a new one.
translation.BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_NOT_SUCCESSFUL: Only successful builds can be downloaded.
translation.BUILDER_DOWNLOAD_REPLACED: A newer _mode_ build replaced this file. Download that one instead.
translation.BUILDER_ERROR_PACKAGE: Use a reverse domain like com.brand.app.
translation.BUILDER_FILE_ERROR: We couldn’t save the file. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_DIMENSIONS_GENERIC: The image doesn’t have the right size.
translation.BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_SIZE: The file must be _size_ or smaller.
translation.BUILDER_FILE_ERROR_TYPE_GENERIC: This type of file isn’t accepted.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_APP_THEME: How your app looks, with no build. Your customers see the active theme the next time they open the app; changes reach them after you publish.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_APPEARANCE: Colors apply on the next build.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_BUILDS: Retrying uses the settings of that attempt. To include newer changes, start a new build.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_CONSTANTS: Constants apply on the next build.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_CREDENTIALS: Used to sign the app on the next build. Passwords and files are never shown again after you save them.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_FILES: Files apply on the next build. Each one is checked against its format and size.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_GENERAL: Changes to the app apply on the next build. The name in Ordering changes right away.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_PUSH: Applies right away, without a build. Use the account of the Firebase project this app uses.
translation.BUILDER_HINT_THEME: How your website looks. Your customers see the active theme; changes reach them after you publish.
translation.BUILDER_INCOMPLETE_HELP: Complete these and try again. Issues marked Ordering don’t stop it.
translation.BUILDER_INSTALL_ANDROID_HELP: Scan with the phone’s camera to download the APK. Android asks to allow installing apps from this source the first time.
translation.BUILDER_INSTALL_HELP: Scan with the iPhone’s camera. Only registered devices can install it.
translation.BUILDER_INSTALL_LINK_ERROR: We couldn’t create the install link. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_INSTALL_NOT_INSTALLABLE: This file can’t be installed on a phone.
translation.BUILDER_INSTALL_NOT_SUCCESSFUL: Only successful builds can be installed.
translation.BUILDER_INSTALL_QR: QR code to install the app
translation.BUILDER_INSTALL_REPLACED: A newer build replaced this file. Install that one instead.
translation.BUILDER_KEYSTORE_GUIDE: How to create a keystore (Google guide)
translation.BUILDER_LOAD_ERROR_HELP: Check your connection and try again.
translation.BUILDER_LOG_ERROR: We couldn’t load the log. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_LOG_NOT_STARTED: There’s no log yet. It appears once the build starts.
translation.BUILDER_LOG_UNAVAILABLE: The build service isn’t responding. Try again in a few minutes.
translation.BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_NEXT: After you save it, activate the website again.
translation.BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TEXT: A website needs a name before it goes active. It’s the name you see in Ordering; your customers don’t see it.
translation.BUILDER_NAME_REQUIRED_TITLE: Add a name to activate this website
translation.BUILDER_NO_ACCESS: You don’t have access to Builder
translation.BUILDER_NO_ACCESS_HELP: Only admins with edit permissions can create and manage apps. Ask a project owner for access.
translation.BUILDER_NO_APPS_HELP: Create a marketplace, store, franchise or driver app. It starts as a free draft.
translation.BUILDER_NO_PRODUCTS_HELP: Create an app or a website. It starts as a free draft.
translation.BUILDER_NOTHING_TO_EDIT: This base has nothing to edit here
translation.BUILDER_OWN_KEYSTORE_CONFIRM_HELP: If this app is already published with the default keystore, the store will reject updates signed with a different one. The default keystore is removed from this app when you save.
translation.BUILDER_PENDING_CHANGES: Changes since this build. Build again to include them.
translation.BUILDER_PLATFORM_PANEL_HELP: Leave a field empty to use the app’s value. Changes apply on the next build.
translation.BUILDER_PLATFORMS_HELP: Platforms you haven’t customized use the app’s name, version and package.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_CHOOSE_HELP: The .json file Firebase downloads for a service account.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_ERROR_FILE: We couldn’t read this file. Choose the .json file Firebase downloaded.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_ERROR_INVALID: This isn’t a Firebase service account. Download it again from Project settings → Service accounts → Generate new private key.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_ERROR_REQUIRED: Choose the .json file or paste its content.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_ERROR_TOO_LONG: This file is too long for a service account. Check that it’s the right one.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE: Push notifications aren’t set up for this project. Contact Ordering support.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_LOAD_ERROR: We couldn’t load the push settings
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_NO_ACCOUNT_HELP: Neither this app nor your project has a Firebase account, so push notifications aren’t sent. Add one to send them.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_OWN_ACCOUNT_HELP: Push notifications to this app’s devices use its own Firebase account.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_PROJECT_ACCOUNT_HELP: Push notifications to this app’s devices use your project’s Firebase account.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_ERROR: We couldn’t remove the account. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVE_HELP: Push notifications to _name_ go back to your project’s account right away, if it has one. If the app uses another Firebase project, they stop arriving.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED: Removed. Push notifications to _name_ use your project’s account.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_REMOVED_NONE: Removed. Push notifications to _name_ aren’t sent until you add an account.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_SAVE_ERROR: We couldn’t save the account. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_SAVED: Saved. Push notifications to _name_ use its own Firebase account.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_CONSOLE: Open the Firebase console and choose the app’s project.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_GENERATE: Click Generate new private key and confirm. Firebase downloads a .json file.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_SETTINGS: Go to Project settings → Service accounts.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_STEP_UPLOAD: Upload that file here. Keep it private: it lets anyone send pushes to your app.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_USE_OWN_HELP: For an app with its own Firebase project. The private key is never shown again after you save it.
translation.BUILDER_PUSH_WHERE_FILE: Where do I get this file?
translation.BUILDER_RESTORED: _name_ is back to the base value
translation.BUILDER_RESTORED_FILE: _name_ is back to the base file
translation.BUILDER_RETRY_ERROR: We couldn’t retry the build. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_RETRY_HELP: It uses the settings of this attempt. Changes you made after it aren’t included: start a new build to use them.
translation.BUILDER_RETRY_NOT_LATEST: Only the latest build of each platform can be retried.
translation.BUILDER_RETRY_NOT_RETRYABLE: This build can’t be retried. Start a new build instead.
translation.BUILDER_RETRY_SOURCE_MISSING: This attempt’s files are no longer kept. Start a new build to use the current settings.
translation.BUILDER_SAVE_ERROR: We couldn’t save it. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_SAVED_NEXT_BUILD: Saved. It applies on the next build.
translation.BUILDER_SITE_LOAD_ERROR: We couldn’t load the website settings
translation.BUILDER_SITE_NO_ACTIVE_THEME: It has no active theme. Its type, store or franchise and these settings apply once you create a theme and activate it.
translation.BUILDER_SITE_NO_ACTIVE_THEME_TITLE: Your website doesn’t use these settings yet
translation.BUILDER_STATUS_DOMAIN_LOCK: A website with its own domain can’t be moved to draft or archived. Remove the domain first.
translation.BUILDER_SUBTITLE: Create your apps, edit them and follow their builds.
translation.BUILDER_SUBTITLE_WEBSITES: Create your apps and websites, edit them and follow their builds.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ACCOUNT_PAGE_HELP: Width and title of profile, orders, favorites, cards, sessions, wallets, gift card, help, addresses and promotions.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ACTIVATE_DRAFT_HELP: Your customers see what you published of it within 5 minutes. Its unpublished changes stay in the editor.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ACTIVATE_ERROR: We couldn’t activate it. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ACTIVATE_HELP: Your customers see it within 5 minutes, instead of the current theme.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ACTIVATED: _name_ is active. Your website shows it within 5 minutes.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ACTIVE_HELP: Your website uses this theme: publishing changes it within 5 minutes.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ANIMATIONS_HELP: Off, nothing on the website moves, whatever each component says.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_AUTH_FORM_HELP: The log-in and sign-up screens, and the one to type a verification code.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BORDER_INTRO: The corners and the border of the elements of your website.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BOTTOM_BARS_HELP: What stays at the bottom of phones: the navigation, and the bars with the cart and checkout buttons.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BOTTOM_BARS_PADDING_HELP: Inside the navigation and inside the cart and checkout bars.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUSINESS_TYPES_HELP: The categories at the top of the store list: pills, pills with the category’s image, or tiles with the image above the name.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUTTON_COLORS_HELP: The fill and the text on it. Outline, tonal and ghost buttons use the fill color for their text and border, darkened when needed so it reads over the page.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUTTON_DISABLED_HELP: A button that cannot be used yet, the same for every color.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUTTON_EACH_SIZE_HELP: The height and the icon of each size. Rounding and text come from Base and Identity.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUTTON_HELP: Each button has a color and a style. Pressed, disabled and light tones follow the color on their own.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUTTON_HOVER_HELP: When the pointer is over the button. Its colors are the button color's tones, so one choice works for every color.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUTTON_PRESSED_HELP: While the button is pressed (and on hover, unless hover has colors of its own). Its colors are the button color's tones.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUTTON_STYLES_HELP: The border and shadow of each style. Their colors come from Button colors.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_BUTTON_USE_MD: Continue, View cart, the header’s buttons
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CARD_HELP: Holds content in coupons, order details, reviews, promotions, wallets, gift cards, sessions, help, reservations, addresses, the free delivery bar and business info.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CHOICE_HELP: An option in a list where one is always chosen, such as delivery instructions, payment methods or tips.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CHOICE_INDICATOR_HELP: The radio circle at the start of each option. It uses Radio’s colors.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CHOICE_INDICATOR_OFF: The chosen option is shown only by its background and border.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CLAMPED_STORED: It was saved outside the range this version of the website takes and was set to the closest limit. It’s saved like that when you save.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_COLOR_ON_OVERLAY_HELP: Text and icons over photos and covers, such as the home and store headers.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_COLORS_HELP: Click a color to change it. Pressed and light tones follow each color on their own.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_COMPONENTS_HELP: Values with a link icon follow a theme color or level, so they change when you change the theme.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CONNECTION_STATUS_HELP: The “Connection status” button signed-in customers see on every page. Pressing it shows when the website last reached the server.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CONTROL_HEIGHTS_HELP: The heights every control shares, so buttons, fields, tabs, chips, choices and switches line up in a row. A control without a size uses Medium.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CREATE_ERROR: We couldn’t create the theme. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CREATE_FROM_CURRENT: Create a new theme from this one
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_AS_IS_RATIO: Its proportion isn’t _ratio_, so it most likely won’t fit well on your website: it may look cut off or leave empty space.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_AS_IS_SIZE: It’s bigger than needed, so it may make your website load slower.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_ERROR: We couldn’t crop the image. Upload it as is or try another one.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_KEYS: Drag the frame or its corners. With the keyboard: arrows move it, + and − resize it.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_LIMIT_TEXT: This image is over the upload limit. Crop it or make it smaller to upload it.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_OVER_LIMIT: It can’t be uploaded as is: it is over the upload limit.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_RATIO_TEXT: This image has a different proportion. Move the frame to choose the part to keep.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_SIZE_TEXT: This image is bigger than needed. We’ll make it smaller so the website loads faster.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CROP_TOO_SMALL_HELP: The result is smaller than the recommended _size_, so it may look blurry on large screens. Choose a bigger part of the image, or use a bigger image.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_CURRENT_UNAVAILABLE: Your current theme can’t be copied. Start from scratch or from a preset.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_DELETE_ACTIVE: Activate another theme before deleting this one.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_DELETE_ERROR: We couldn’t delete it. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_DISCARD_ERROR: We couldn’t discard the draft. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_DISCARD_HELP: The theme goes back to what you last published. Changes you haven’t saved are lost too.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_EASING_HELP: How a movement starts and ends.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_EMPTY_STATE_HELP: What a page shows when it has nothing yet: no orders, no favorites, no results.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_FIELD_HELP: Around each field of a form: its label, help and error messages, and the space between fields.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_FOCUS_RING_HELP: The ring around a button, a field or a link reached with the keyboard.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_FONT_WEIGHTS_HELP: Each font has its own weights: the type scale offers the ones it has.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ICON_BUTTONS_HELP: Square buttons with only an icon. They take any color, style and size, like any button.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ICON_SIZES_HELP: Icons in buttons, fields, lists and menus.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGE_LINK_INVALID: Enter a link that starts with https://
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGE_SAFE: Keep what matters in the middle _ratio_: the edges may be cut
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGE_SMALL_TEXT: Yours is _yours_ and the recommended size is _size_, so it may look blurry on large screens.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGE_SMALL_TITLE: This image is smaller than recommended
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGE_UPLOAD_ERROR: We couldn’t upload the image. Try again.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_APP_ICON_HELP: On phones’ home screens and the app banner. Keep the design inside the central circle (80%): some phones crop the corners.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_EMPTY_NOT_FOUND_HEL: Also for the empty lists without an image of their own.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_FAVICON_HELP: A square PNG, SVG or ICO. A PNG shows in every browser; with an SVG, older Safari versions show the default icon.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_HELP: Upload a file or use a link. An empty image uses the website’s standard one.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_ISOTYPE_HELP: The brand symbol without its name. The header shows it on phones.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_MAP_MARKER_HELP: The bottom center of the image marks the place on the map.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_ORDER_TYPES_RESERVA: Empty, it uses the Eat in image.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_PLACEHOLDER_BUSINES: On the store cards of the stores without a cover.
For the stores without a logo.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_PLACEHOLDER_GIFT_CA: For the gift cards without an image.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_PLACEHOLDER_LOYALTY: For the loyalty levels without an image.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_PLACEHOLDER_PRODUCT: For the products without a photo, when Visibility shows it.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INACTIVE_HELP: This theme isn’t active, so publishing doesn’t change your website until you activate it.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INVALID: Some values aren’t valid. Check the marked fields.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INVALID_ALIAS: This value follows one the theme no longer has. Choose another one.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INVALID_ALPHA: This color can’t be transparent. Choose an opaque one.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INVALID_FORMAT: This image’s format isn’t taken here. Upload it in one of the formats below.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INVALID_HIDDEN: Some values aren’t valid and the editor doesn’t show them. They’re listed above the editor.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INVALID_RANGE: This value is outside the range it takes. Choose another one.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INVALID_STORED: It was saved before this version of the website and is dropped when you save.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_INVALID_VALUE: This value isn’t valid. Choose another one.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ITEM_RADIUS_FULL: Only for inset options. Full width options are square.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_JOIN_TABS_HELP: One block: only the first and last tabs keep their outer corners rounded.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_LAYOUT_INTRO: How the pages of the whole website are arranged.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_LAYOUT_MODE_APPOINTMENTS_H: For booking services: the store list gets type and price filters, and My orders and Favorites get a Professionals tab.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_LAYOUT_MODE_HELP: Changes the store list, My orders and Favorites. The other pages look the same in both.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_LEAVE_HELP: You have changes you haven’t saved. They’ll be lost.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_LIMIT: You already have 5 themes. Delete one to create another.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_LINE_UNDER_TABS_HELP: The line across the whole bar; “No line” takes it away.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_MOTION_INTRO: How things move on your website: menus opening, switches, bars filling.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_N_CLAMPED: _count_ saved values are outside the range this version of the website takes: they were set to the closest limit, and they’re saved like that when you save. The editor marks them where it shows them.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_N_INVALID: _count_ saved values aren’t valid in this version of the website: they’re dropped when you save. The editor marks them where it shows them.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_NO_PRESETS: There are no presets for this kind of website yet.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_NOTICE: Customers see it within 5 minutes. Unpublished changes stay in the editor until you publish them.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_NOTICE_TITLE: Activating a theme changes your website for everyone
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ON_HOVER_HELP: When the pointer is over the card. Only the shadow changes; cards never lift or move.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ONE_CLAMPED: 1 saved value is outside the range this version of the website takes: it was set to the closest limit, and it’s saved like that when you save. The editor marks it where it shows it.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_ONE_INVALID: 1 saved value isn’t valid in this version of the website: it’s dropped when you save. The editor marks it where it shows it.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_OPACITY_DISABLED_HELP: Buttons, chips, checkboxes and switches that can’t be used fade to it.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_OPACITY_PRESSED_HELP: Links fade to it while pressed.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_OPTION_NEW_PAGE: On a page of its own
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGE_FOOTER_HELP: Whether this page ends with the footer. The whole website’s choice is in the Footer component.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGE_FOOTER_PLATFORM_HELP: Whether this page ends with the footer on phones.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGE_GUTTER_HELP: Between the edge of the screen and the content.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGE_NO_SECTIONS: This page has no sections to move or hide.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGE_SECTIONS_AS_ALL_SCREE: Phones show them as on all screens.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGE_SECTIONS_FIXED_HELP: These sections keep their place. Hide the ones you don’t need.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGE_SECTIONS_HELP: Drag a section, or use its arrows, to change the order. Each one moves within its block; the ones with a lock keep their place.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGE_SECTIONS_OWN_PLATFORM: Order and hide them differently on phones
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PAGES_HELP: Which sections each page shows, in what order, and whether it ends with the footer.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PART_ERROR: This part of the editor couldn’t be shown. The rest still works.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PIECES_HELP: Each piece is always the same component: pick its size and style among that component’s. A dash means the piece doesn’t have that choice.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PLATFORM_MOBILE_WEB_HELP: On small screens these replace Base’s values. Each starts at its own value for phones, whatever Base has.
translation.BUILDER_THEME_PLATFORM_VISIBILITY_HELP: What phones show. Until you change one here, it shows as on all screens, or as the website has it on phones.
